item.title: Lindung 24/7 Must Remain Mandatory For Everyone’s Benefit
item.description:
Source: CodeBlue (Malaysia Health)
Lindung 24/7 must remain mandatory because social insurance only works when everyone, both rich and poor, contributes. Otherwise, it's unsustainable with a small risk pool; contribution rates may spike and claims get denied, like private health insurance. item.description:
